name: Beauty Darling
original_name: ビューティーダーリン
source:
He does have a girlfriend... kind of.
But something’s clearly off, and his real-life relationships just aren’t going well.

You play as our unremarkable, unlucky-in-love male protagonist, who ends up seeking advice from Shiki Mihara—a fabulous, sharp-tongued bartender with an unmistakable flair.
Before he knows it, he’s hit with a wild suggestion: “Why not try becoming a girl?”

And so begins a romantic adventure where he, still very much a man inside, tries to understand the heart of a woman.

[Edited from [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/beautydarling-switch]Nintendo[/url]]
